summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting resolutions from its General Ordinary and Extraordinary and Special Ordinary Class A and D Shareholders Meeting held on April 30, 2026, with 86.32% of capital stock represented. The meeting approved routine matters: signing of minutes, consideration of annual reports and financial statements for fiscal year 2025, absorption of losses and constitution of voluntary reserves, waiver of preemptive rights for share-based compensation plans, and appointment of Deloitte as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026. This is a standard annual meeting submission with no special-situations event.
